### Summary
Changes to recipe:  **cmake/4.5.0**

#### Motivation
Update CMake to version 4.5.0, which finally adds official support for `import std` (see [release notes](https://cmake.org/cmake/help/latest/release/4.5.html#languages)).

#### Details
As instructed in config.yml, replaced 4.4.4 with 4.5.0 and updated SHA256 hashes according to [cmake-4.5.0-SHA-256.txt](https://github.com/Kitware/CMake/releases/download/v4.5.0/cmake-4.5.0-SHA-256.txt).


---
- [x] Read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/conan-io/conan-center-index/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Checked that this PR is not a duplicate: [list of PRs by recipe](https://github.com/conan-io/conan-center-index/discussions/24240)
- [ ] If this is a bug fix, please link related issue or provide bug details
- [x] Tested locally with at least one configuration using a recent version of Conan

---
Add a :+1: reaction to pull requests you find [important](https://github.com/conan-io/conan-center-index/pulls?q=is%3Aopen+sort%3Areactions-%2B1-desc) to help the team prioritize, thanks!
items.title: CMake: update to version 4.5.0
